body: Founder: 'can we start crunching the data on the heroes that are the strongest?' -> 'ok i want to start tracking it on okemily.com' -> 'wotan.okemily.com dns already exists.' New 'REDGARDEN hero strength' section on tournaments.html, fetching IDUNA's new GET /api/v1/redgarden/hero-leaderboard (Apple #11320). Deployed live via okemily-deploy.sh, verified working over HTTPS. Also drafted ops/nginx-wotan.conf serving the same static root with tournaments.html as index -- not yet live, needs the founder's own sudo to install the vhost + certbot TLS cert.
title: feat: REDGARDEN hero win-rate leaderboard on tournaments.html + wotan.okemily.com nginx draft
